description: Deterministic, version-controlled reference registry for common packaged food and sports nutrition ingredients.

ingredients.function: Supplemental dairy protein providing rapid amino acid delivery with intact bioactive peptides and natural milk minerals.
ingredients.evidence_summary: Dairy-derived fast-digesting protein rich in essential and branched-chain amino acids (BCAAs), particularly leucine. Typically 70-80% protein concentration by dry weight.
ingredients.fitness_context: Commonly used post-workout or across meals to support muscle protein synthesis, recovery, and daily protein targets.
ingredients.provenance: NutriForge Curated Food Science Registry v1.0 (Codex CXS 284-1971)

synonyms: cross flow microfiltered whey protein isolate
ingredients.function: High-purity supplemental protein source processed to minimize lactose, carbohydrate, and dietary fat content.
ingredients.evidence_summary: Cross-flow micro-filtered or ion-exchanged whey protein achieving >=90% protein by dry weight with negligible lactose and lipid content.
ingredients.fitness_context: Rapidly absorbed protein source suited for post-workout recovery or athletes on strict caloric/macronutrient limits.
ingredients.provenance: NutriForge Curated Food Science Registry v1.0 (Codex CXS 284-1971)

ingredients.function: Intact dairy protein ingredient preserving the natural 80:20 casein-to-whey ratio of cow milk.
ingredients.evidence_summary: Concentrated from skim milk via ultrafiltration; retains both micellar casein and whey proteins with an intermediate digestion rate.
ingredients.fitness_context: Provides sustained amino acid delivery and high satiety in blended protein supplements and meal replacements.
ingredients.provenance: NutriForge Curated Food Science Registry v1.0

ingredients.function: High-purity intact dairy protein containing >=90% protein on dry basis.
ingredients.evidence_summary: Derived by ultrafiltration and diafiltration of skim milk to remove lactose and minerals while preserving native casein and whey micelles.
ingredients.fitness_context: High-concentration dairy protein offering both fast and slow amino acid kinetics for prolonged anabolic response.
ingredients.provenance: NutriForge Curated Food Science Registry v1.0

ingredients.function: Plant-derived protein isolate with high protein density (>=90% dry basis).
ingredients.evidence_summary: Produced from defatted soybean flakes by aqueous extraction and isoelectric precipitation. Provides a complete amino acid profile with a PDCAAS of ~1.0.
ingredients.fitness_context: Vegetarian and vegan supplemental protein source supporting muscle repair, strength, and lean mass accretion.
ingredients.provenance: NutriForge Curated Food Science Registry v1.0 (Codex CXS 175-1989)

ingredients.function: Plant-derived functional protein ingredient containing approximately 65-70% protein.
ingredients.evidence_summary: Prepared from dehulled and defatted soybeans by removing soluble carbohydrates while retaining natural insoluble dietary fiber and proteins.
ingredients.fitness_context: Provides plant-based protein fortifying bars, cereals, and meat-alternative sports foods.
ingredients.provenance: NutriForge Curated Food Science Registry v1.0

ingredients.function: Slow-release dairy protein that forms a stable clot or gel in the acidic environment of the stomach.
ingredients.evidence_summary: Separated from milk via microfiltration without chemical precipitation, preserving natural micellar structures for slow gastric emptying (up to 7-8 hours).
ingredients.fitness_context: Widely used as a nighttime or extended-fast protein to provide sustained anti-catabolic amino acid release into the bloodstream.
ingredients.provenance: NutriForge Curated Food Science Registry v1.0

ingredients.function: Soluble casein salt used for protein fortification, emulsification, and heat stability.
ingredients.evidence_summary: Prepared from acid casein curd neutralized with food-grade calcium hydroxide; highly soluble with slow-to-moderate digestion kinetics.
ingredients.fitness_context: Supplies bioavailable calcium and slow-digesting protein in sports nutritional bars and ready-to-drink shakes.
ingredients.provenance: NutriForge Curated Food Science Registry v1.0

ingredients.function: Supplemental cellular energy substrate that increases intramuscular phosphocreatine pools.
ingredients.evidence_summary: Extensively validated dietary supplement. Phosphorylates ADP to regenerate ATP during short-duration, high-intensity anaerobic exercise.
ingredients.fitness_context: Strongly substantiated by sports science literature for increasing maximal strength, power output, training volume, and lean body mass.
ingredients.provenance: NutriForge Curated Food Science Registry v1.0 (ISSN Position Stand: Creatine)

ingredients.function: Nonsweet or mildly sweet polysaccharide carbohydrate hydrolysate used for rapid energy, bulking, and mouthfeel.
ingredients.evidence_summary: Produced by partial enzymatic or acid hydrolysis of starch (corn, rice, potato, or wheat). Features a high glycemic index (typically 85-105).
ingredients.fitness_context: Utilized in intra-workout carbohydrate powders and mass gainers for rapid gastric emptying and post-exercise glycogen replenishment.
ingredients.provenance: NutriForge Curated Food Science Registry v1.0

ingredients.function: Disaccharide caloric sweetener providing sweetness, body, moisture retention, and rapid energy.
ingredients.evidence_summary: Disaccharide composed of 50% D-glucose and 50% D-fructose linked by glycosidic bond; yields 4 kcal/g and contributes to total and added sugars.
ingredients.fitness_context: Nutritive carbohydrate providing quick fuel during high-intensity training; excess intake may conflict with calorie-restricted fitness goals.
ingredients.provenance: NutriForge Curated Food Science Registry v1.0 (Codex CXS 212-1999)

ingredients.function: Viscous aqueous solution of nutritive saccharides obtained by starch hydrolysis.
ingredients.evidence_summary: Contains glucose, maltose, and oligosaccharides. Modulates crystallization, viscosity, and sweetness in processed energy bars and confections.
ingredients.fitness_context: Caloric carbohydrate ingredient contributing to rapid glucose availability and declared added sugars on food labels.
ingredients.provenance: NutriForge Curated Food Science Registry v1.0 (Codex CXS 212-1999)

ingredients.function: High-intensity non-caloric artificial sweetener roughly 600 times sweeter than sucrose.
ingredients.evidence_summary: Chlorinated sucrose molecule that passes through the human digestive tract largely unabsorbed, contributing zero net calories or glycemic impact.
ingredients.fitness_context: Enables zero-sugar sweetening in whey proteins, BCAAs, and pre-workout formulas without increasing caloric intake.
ingredients.provenance: NutriForge Curated Food Science Registry v1.0 (Codex Alimentarius INS 955)

ingredients.function: High-potency plant-derived non-caloric sweetener.
ingredients.evidence_summary: Purified extract of steviol glycosides from Stevia rebaudiana leaves, approximately 200-350 times sweeter than sucrose with negligible caloric contribution.
ingredients.fitness_context: Plant-derived non-nutritive sweetener favored in naturally sweetened fitness supplements and functional foods.
ingredients.provenance: NutriForge Curated Food Science Registry v1.0 (Codex Alimentarius INS 960)

ingredients.function: Heat-stable high-intensity calorie-free sweetener approximately 200 times sweeter than sucrose.
ingredients.evidence_summary: Synthetic potassium salt of an oxathiazinone dioxide derivative; excreted unchanged by the kidneys without caloric conversion.
ingredients.fitness_context: Commonly paired synergistically with sucralose to create a rounded sweetness profile in sugar-free sports nutrition products.
ingredients.provenance: NutriForge Curated Food Science Registry v1.0 (Codex Alimentarius INS 950)

ingredients.function: Natural phospholipid surfactant that facilitates wetting, dispersion, and instantization of hydrophobic powders.
ingredients.evidence_summary: Complex mixture of phospholipids (phosphatidylcholine, phosphatidylethanolamine, phosphatidylinositol) extracted from soybean oil refining.
ingredients.fitness_context: Enables protein powders to disperse smoothly in cold liquids with minimal shaker-cup clumping.
ingredients.provenance: NutriForge Curated Food Science Registry v1.0 (Codex Alimentarius INS 322)

ingredients.function: Non-soy plant phospholipid emulsifier and instantizing agent.
ingredients.evidence_summary: Phospholipid complex extracted from mechanically pressed or solvent-extracted sunflower seeds, avoiding major common food allergens.
ingredients.fitness_context: Provides powder solubility and dispersion in allergen-sensitive and soy-free sports supplements.
ingredients.provenance: NutriForge Curated Food Science Registry v1.0

ingredients.function: Hydrocolloid polysaccharide used to impart viscosity, prevent particle settling, and create smooth mouthfeel.
ingredients.evidence_summary: Exocellular polysaccharide produced by pure culture fermentation of carbohydrate by Xanthomonas campestris; effective at very low dosages (0.1-0.3%).
ingredients.fitness_context: Gives protein shakes a thicker, milkshake-like texture and prevents cocoa or insoluble proteins from settling at the bottom.
ingredients.provenance: NutriForge Curated Food Science Registry v1.0 (Codex Alimentarius INS 415)

ingredients.function: Galactomannan polysaccharide used for cold-water hydration, thickening, and stabilizing suspensions.
ingredients.evidence_summary: Milled endosperm of Cyamopsis tetragonoloba seeds. Provides dietary soluble fiber and pseudoplastic rheology in aqueous solutions.
ingredients.fitness_context: Enhances texture, satiety, and body in meal replacement powders and protein pudding mixes.
ingredients.provenance: NutriForge Curated Food Science Registry v1.0 (Codex Alimentarius INS 412)

ingredients.function: Organic food acid providing characteristic tartness, pH control, and antioxidant synergism.
ingredients.evidence_summary: Tricarboxylic acid naturally found in citrus fruits; commercially produced via microbial fermentation of glucose substrates.
ingredients.fitness_context: Provides refreshing tart flavor profiles in fruity protein isolate drinks, intra-workout electrolytes, and pre-workout formulas.
ingredients.provenance: NutriForge Curated Food Science Registry v1.0 (Codex Alimentarius INS 330)

ingredients.function: Essential mineral electrolyte compound providing sodium and chloride ions for osmotic balance and flavor enhancement.
ingredients.evidence_summary: Inorganic crystalline ionic compound containing ~39.3% sodium and ~60.7% chloride by weight. Essential for cellular fluid homeostasis and nerve conduction.
ingredients.fitness_context: Crucial electrolyte lost via perspiration; supports muscular contractility, vascular volume, and intra-workout hydration balance.
ingredients.provenance: NutriForge Curated Food Science Registry v1.0 (Codex CXS 150-1985)

ingredients.function: Naturally derived particulate flavoring agent providing chocolate flavor, natural color, and polyphenol compounds.
ingredients.evidence_summary: Derived from roasted, fermented, and pressed Theobroma cacao seeds. Contains dietary fiber, trace minerals (iron, magnesium), and flavanol antioxidants.
ingredients.fitness_context: Standard natural flavoring in chocolate-flavored protein powders and bars, contributing small amounts of fiber and dietary minerals.
ingredients.provenance: NutriForge Curated Food Science Registry v1.0 (Codex CXS 105-1981)

ingredients.function: Plant-based edible oil providing essential dietary fatty acids, smooth mouthfeel, and caloric energy.
ingredients.evidence_summary: Triglyceride matrix extracted from Helianthus annuus seeds, rich in monounsaturated (oleic) or polyunsaturated (linoleic) fatty acids and vitamin E.
ingredients.fitness_context: Used as a fat source in nutrition bars and mass gainers to deliver dietary calories and maintain pliable texture.
ingredients.provenance: NutriForge Curated Food Science Registry v1.0 (Codex CXS 210-1999)

ingredients.function: Minimally processed cereal grain base offering complex starch, soluble beta-glucan fiber, and plant micronutrients.
ingredients.evidence_summary: Dehulled and steamed oat groats rolled into flat flakes. High in beta-glucan, shown to modulate postprandial glucose and assist blood lipid profiles.
ingredients.fitness_context: Staple complex carbohydrate for bodybuilding and endurance diets, providing sustained low-GI energy release and satiety.
ingredients.provenance: NutriForge Curated Food Science Registry v1.0

ingredients.function: Nutrient-dense whole-food tree nut providing monounsaturated fatty acids, plant protein, dietary fiber, and micronutrients.
ingredients.evidence_summary: Edible seeds of Prunus dulcis. Rich in oleic acid, alpha-tocopherol (vitamin E), riboflavin, and dietary magnesium.
ingredients.fitness_context: Whole-food source of healthy fats and protein, promoting prolonged satiety and cardiovascular nutrition in sports snack formulations.
ingredients.provenance: NutriForge Curated Food Science Registry v1.0

ingredients.function: Hypoallergenic plant-derived protein isolate (typically 80-85% protein concentration).
ingredients.evidence_summary: Extracted from yellow split peas (Pisum sativum) using aqueous isolation. Rich in BCAAs, lysine, arginine, and iron; naturally free of lactose and gluten.
ingredients.fitness_context: Widely used vegan protein supplement supporting muscle protein synthesis comparable to whey in clinical trial settings.
ingredients.provenance: NutriForge Curated Food Science Registry v1.0

ingredients.function: Hypoallergenic grain protein concentrate/isolate containing approximately 80% protein.
ingredients.evidence_summary: Produced by enzymatically treating whole brown rice grain to isolate protein fractions. High in sulfur amino acids (methionine and cysteine).
ingredients.fitness_context: Frequently combined with pea protein in a 70:30 or 50:50 ratio to achieve a complementary plant-based complete amino acid profile.
ingredients.provenance: NutriForge Curated Food Science Registry v1.0

ingredients.function: Simple monosaccharide sugar used for rapid energy provision and mild sweetness.
ingredients.evidence_summary: Pure D-glucose isomer yielding 4 kcal/g with a glycemic index of 100. Absorbed directly in the small intestine without requiring enzymatic cleavage.
ingredients.fitness_context: Used in post-workout nutrition shakes to spike insulin and rapidly refill depleted glycogen reserves.
ingredients.provenance: NutriForge Curated Food Science Registry v1.0 (Codex CXS 212-1999)

ingredients.function: Essential water-soluble micronutrient and antioxidant preserving product freshness and preventing nutrient oxidation.
ingredients.evidence_summary: Essential cofactor in collagen biosynthesis, carnitine transport, and catecholamine neurotransmitter synthesis; potent reducing agent.
ingredients.fitness_context: Micronutrient supporting cellular antioxidant defense, immune response, and collagen synthesis in joint tissues.
ingredients.provenance: NutriForge Curated Food Science Registry v1.0 (Codex Alimentarius INS 300)

ingredients.function: Mineral salt providing potassium ions for electrolyte supplementation, flavor enhancement, and sodium reduction.
ingredients.evidence_summary: Inorganic salt providing ~52.4% potassium and ~47.6% chloride by weight. Critical for maintaining resting membrane potential and cardiac electrophysiology.
ingredients.fitness_context: Key intracellular electrolyte supporting normal muscular contractility, hydration balance, and cramp prevention during extended exercise.
ingredients.provenance: NutriForge Curated Food Science Registry v1.0 (Codex Alimentarius INS 508)
